evidence.title: Ferstar reports a commercial snapshot repeatedly failed upload, while a small public repository snapshot was accepted.
evidence.observation: Ferstar reports a commercial snapshot repeatedly failed upload, while a small public repository snapshot was accepted. Disabling visible privacy settings reportedly did not disable packaging/upload.
evidence.limitations: Local investigation is not a population audit. Do not report the failed commercial upload as completed exfiltration. Historical server retention and deletion remain unverified. Vendor statement direct access failed; material disputes about rationale or deletion remain outside this bounded observation.
